chapter: Larry in Chicago and New York
title: Where Larry's style came from
summary: Wiggs asks who inspired Larry; Harry guesses Freddie Burns and describes house parties with his brothers' friends.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Where would you think Larry got his inspiration, his idea of style? You got any idea? I really... Who would have been before him to... You know how everybody has somebody that they like very much in a jazz musical way.

Yeah, I think everybody is inspired, John, but I really don't know who inspired Larry. Maybe it could have been Freddie Burns. Because he was always at the house with my older brothers playing, you know. And I had three sisters and them, the girls in the neighborhood, you know, and the boys in the neighborhood. They'd give a little party in the house and of course my brothers would get King Watsky and Buzz Harvey and the guys to come over and they'd play, you know, and have a lot of fun.
